mostWorthwhile.text: Following the surviving clumps into new stars brought the earlier pillars' story to a satisfying conclusion.

leastWorthwhile.text: The dust-outflow combination was a straightforward intermediate result without much explanation on its own.

surprise.text: Fast particles in the hot outer gas erode dust grains, returning their material to the gas.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt notably arbitrary; the offered dust paths had clear purposes, though compatibility was supplied by the menu.

continue.text: I would continue to see what happens to the newly formed stars and their surroundings; the contrasting dust outcomes made this chapter interesting.
